richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kulti

c: Kulti belongs to the Asansol coal and steel belt in western West Bengal, an area of old industrial colonies, railway quarters and schools with open grounds. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kulti for colony committees, schools, clubs and the civic body. We make every machine at our Vasai factory, about 1520 km away, and send it by road.

Summers in this part of Bengal are hot and dry, and the winters are short and cool. Equipment in an older colony park often gets years of use with little attention, so we think about upkeep from the first drawing. Our 1-year warranty covers springs, bearings and spare parts, and our after-sales team can arrange replacement parts later. A short checklist at handover helps the caretaker spot problems early.

items.q: Can I get spare parts for outdoor gym equipment in Kulti?
items.a: Yes. Call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or write to aftersales@funplaysystems.com with the machine name and photos. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty.

items.q: Which machines work for both young and old users?
items.a: Twisters, walkers and chest presses suit most ages because they use body weight and need no adjustment. We can add pull-up or parallel bars for younger users if the ground allows.

items.q: How is the equipment installed on hard, uneven ground?
items.a: Usually by grouting each machine into a concrete footing. Our team or a local dealer levels the footing first, so the machine stands straight even when the ground around it is uneven.
